title: A summary layer I can clone and edit; vignettes strengthen or weaken assumptions; I can only affirm in context, and a domain is our current best guess (2026-11-06)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
This little experiment shows me somethign very interesting. AI takes te fragments places them into categories of data within the domain. 

What I can then see coming is an AI produced summary of the text that sits a layer up. I should also be able to clone and edit that summary. I may not even be certain of that text, but it will help me to understand better. 

Over time, we collect more of this information. A conversation will return to this topic and those vignettes will strengthen or weaken the assumptions we may have made about a topic. 

Gradually the confidence in a set of statements will grow - but an affirmation is still something that we should not assume is the goal. 

I can only affirm in context. When I see a statement, I need to see whats next to it. And what contains it. A domain is just our current best guess.   This is synthesis work - it is always relative to it's context. 

take a look at this dataset. 

This took me 6 months with multiple iterations
